workflow: A compound operation begins on an object and invokes user-controlled conversion code to obtain an operand.
The conversion callback mutates the original object’s runtime type while the operation is still in progress.
The operation continues using the implementation selected for the object’s former type without revalidating the mutation.
The stale implementation accesses the object under incompatible type assumptions, causing a null-pointer dereference and process termination instead of a recoverable type error.
summary: Re-entrant type mutation leaves stale operation dispatch
decision_reason: No existing cluster captures the materially distinct failure workflow: user-controlled conversion code changes an operand’s type during an active operation, after which stale type-specific dispatch is invoked. The closest re-entrancy and stale-state clusters concern cleanup or cached execution state
